svg.title: Maxwell–Boltzmann distribution
svg.desc: Two Maxwell-Boltzmann curves showing the relative number of atoms at each energy, for the same gas at two temperatures. The hotter sample's curve has a lower, broader peak shifted to higher energy, while the cooler sample's is taller and narrower. The whole shape of the curve is set by the temperature, which is the feature this diagram exists to teach. Illustrative data.
svg.text: The shape of the curve is set by the temperature of the gas
AP Physics 2 asks for the features of the curve, not its functional form.
